failures.assertion: Cites snapshot file paths (such as docs/metrics.md or docs/feedback.md) for factual claims, cites no file outside the snapshot, and labels claims the snapshot does not support as hypotheses or unknowns.
failures.evidence: Two line citations point to the wrong roadmap lines: "ignore the stale line at ROADMAP.md:5" refers to streak reminders, which are on line 4 (line 5 is shared challenges), and "ROADMAP.md:7" refers to dark mode, which is on line 6 of a six-line file; unlabeled estimates such as "more than 6 weeks of work across two platform health APIs" also appear.
